description: A React component implementing a toolbar with various actions for a Kanban board, including exporting/importing cards, managing columns, fullscreen toggle, and undo functionality.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and triggers download of an Excel template for bulk card creation, with predefined columns and sample data.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Callback to open modal for adding a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission to add a new column after user input.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Handles Excel file upload, parses the sheet, and populates modal for bulk upload.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Confirms bulk upload, processes CSV data against selected column, and inserts cards.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards as a CSV and triggers browser download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Handles CSV file selection, parses header, and shows preview/confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV re-import/sync, updating existing cards or inserting new ones.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV sync, restoring previous state.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
